questions.q: What must be true about a data factory's name?
options: It must be globally unique across all of Azure, not just your own subscription
It only needs to be unique within your own resource group
It can be reused across multiple subscriptions with no restriction
It must match the name of an existing resource group
questions.explain: Data factory names are globally unique across every Azure customer. If your first choice is already taken, you'll need to pick a different one.

questions.q: Which Data Factory version should you select when creating a new factory today?
options: V2
V1
V3
There's no version selection when creating a data factory
questions.explain: V1 still exists for backward compatibility with very old factories, but V2 is current, and every feature this course covers assumes V2.

questions.q: What does the Region setting actually control when creating a data factory?
options: Where the data factory's metadata is stored — not necessarily where your data lives
The physical location of every data source it will ever connect to
Which browser you're allowed to use with Data Factory Studio
The billing currency for the subscription
questions.explain: The region is where the data factory's own metadata lives. The actual data stores and compute it connects to can be in entirely different regions.

questions.q: What does selecting "Launch studio" from a data factory's Azure portal overview page do?
options: Opens Azure Data Factory Studio, the actual authoring tool
Deletes the data factory
Downloads the data factory's configuration as a file
Immediately runs every pipeline in the factory
questions.explain: The Azure portal overview page is Resource Manager's view of the resource itself. "Launch studio" opens the separate tool (adf.azure.com) where you actually build pipelines.

questions.q: What's the most likely cause if the browser gets stuck on "Authorizing" after selecting Launch studio?
options: A third-party cookie block, fixable by adding an exception for login.microsoftonline.com
The data factory was created in the wrong region
The subscription has run out of available data factories
Data Factory Studio is permanently down
questions.explain: This is a well-known snag — either clear the browser's third-party cookie block entirely, or add a specific exception for login.microsoftonline.com.
